about: Human-eye review of the cut-out stickers, read by publish.mjs. A sticker listed under `rejected` is never published, whatever its automated checks say.
reviewer: Visual review during the build session (checkerboard, dark and light backgrounds, review sheets in .work/stickers/review-*.png)

notes.emph-circle-scribble: First take had a filled cream centre, useless for circling something; fixed with an edit turn so the inside of the ring is transparent.
notes.react-thumbs-up: First take ran its sleeve off the frame edge, leaving no white border on that side; fixed with an edit turn.
notes.celebrate-confetti: First take reached the frame edges; an edit turn gathered it into one burst. Its green was slightly uneven (spread 24.7), which only warns: the cut itself passed every other check and looks clean.
notes.play-baobab: Painted on magenta because the subject is a tree; the leaves came out teal rather than green, which suits the palette.
notes.label-*: Every label reads exactly as briefed and is legible at small sizes.
